name: Metalcraft Meet
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to schedule and manage video meetings via Metalcraft Meet (meet.metalcraftai.com). One call schedules a meeting — it mints a join URL, adds the event to the user's Metalcraft Calendar, and emails the invitees (each gets a personal join link + an .ics). List/get/reschedule/cancel meetings and add participants (writes need the write scope). Resolve people through Metalcraft Contacts first, so 'schedule a call with Alice and Bob' becomes real email addresses. Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. The API base is fixed to https://meet.metalcraftai.com.
